summary: AI Era Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a Vice Chairman Agreement with Mark Iwanowski, a partner at Pegasus Tech Ventures, in an advisory, non-executive capacity. No cash compensation; only $150,000 annual NSOs. This is a routine consulting/advisor appointment, not a special situation event such as a takeover, restructuring, or management change. No transaction, tender, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a standard material definitive agreement disclosure.
